_comment: The calendar. A day is a Pulse; Pulses are named in order within each Cycle (ordinal names: Firstday, Secondday...). A Turn is: Light Duel, 4 intercalary Pulses, Dark Duel, 4 intercalary Pulses. The game's day count (day 1, 2...) is laid onto this starting at start_turn / start_pulse_of_turn (1 = the first Pulse of the Light Duel). The game begins at the start of Turn 211 (Turn 1 was more than three millennia earlier; Bytorsskug was founded in Turn 120). Time passes in the game: a Pulse for every move from one area to another (city to hunt, area to area, back home), and a whole Cycle (9 Pulses) when a hunt is completed.
